### Knowing God's Will
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/knowing-gods-will
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 4:3
Points:
- Believers often agonize over God's hidden plans while overlooking His clearly revealed priority.
- Scripture plainly reveals that God's foremost will for our lives is our ongoing sanctification.
- Secular culture prioritizes self-fulfillment and personal happiness over moral purity and obedience.
- Walking in God's will may require sacrificing personal comfort to remain faithful to Christ.
- The Holy Spirit provides the grace and power needed to turn from sin and grow in holiness.

### Ambition
Author: Shawn McEvoy
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-apr-1-2008-11571987.html
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 4:11
Points:
- Modern culture defines ambition in terms of chasing status, wealth, and public recognition.
- Scripture redirects Christian ambition toward leading a quiet life, working hard, and minding one's own affairs.
- Avoiding gossip and busybody behavior frees believers to serve God faithfully in ordinary tasks.
- True Christian ambition centers on knowing the Lord, pleasing Him, and sharing the gospel.
- Embracing humble, quiet faithfulness fulfills God's basic design for our daily walk of faith.
